The '''ancient ruins''' of a [[City/Legends|city]] were located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nentan]]. They city had been constructed by an [[Unidentified species (Nentan)|unidentified alien species]]. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Species/Legends|species]] that originally built the city had long been forgotten.
